donts: Don't add kickers, gradient text, glass, emoji icons, or >1px accent borders.
Don't exceed text-5xl or tighten tracking past -0.04em.
Don't invent new accent hues beyond court green + shuttle yellow + lamps.
dos: Do render every rupiah tabular and snap hero totals on change.
Do keep yellow to one action per screen; active states go green.
Do divide lanes with 1px lines; scoreCls only for bill panels.
keyCharacteristics: Scoreboard panels: near-black green, hairline borders, light tabular numerals.
Lanes over cards: neutral rows, 1px dividers, no accent stripes.
One loud color: shuttlecock-yellow for the primary action only.
Lamps, not badges: paid/status read as glowing dots.
narrative.overview: Badminton Split looks like the world it serves: a GOR scoreboard above court lines. Deep court-green shells, one shuttlecock-yellow action per screen, tabular figures that snap on change, lanes divided by 1px court lines.

rules.body: Shuttlecock-yellow appears on at most one action per screen. Its rarity is the point.
rules.name: The One Loud Color Rule

rules.body: Every rupiah amount renders tabular; hero totals snap via key + animate-score-snap.
rules.name: The Scoreboard Figures Rule

rules.body: Separation relies on 1px lines; shadows never carry meaning.
rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
